# Figure 3

-   Analysis - Review scATACseq and integrate with scRNAseq


# Fig 1A

-   ATAC and RNA integrated UMAPs

## ARC

```{r}
ARC <- readRDS("../Data.Objects/seuOBJ_snRNA_snATAC_allSample_ARC_merge_subClust.rds")

```

```{R, fig3A.ARC.UMAP, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, dev=c('png', 'pdf')}
ARC$cluster <- factor(ARC$cluster, levels=as.character(sort(as.numeric(unique(ARC$cluster)))))

DimPlot(ARC, split.by = "tech", group.by = "cluster")
```

## PVH

```{R}
PVH <- readRDS("../Data.Objects/seuOBJ_snRNA_snATAC_allSample_PVH_merge_subClust.rds")

```

```{R, fig3A.PVH.UMAP, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, dev=c('png', 'pdf')}

```

# Fig 1B

-   ATAC *Gene Activity* score per cluster for marker genes

## ARC

```{R}

mark_ge <- c("Npy","Ccbe1","Dach2","Tmem26","Pomc",
             "Sntb1","Vgll3","Tcf7l2","Sv2b","Hydin","Mcc",
             "Col24a1","Pdgfd","Colec12","Lmo7","Megf11","Nfib","Qrfpr","Alk",
             "Pdzrn3","Gem","Sim1","Bnc2","Sema3e","Unc13c","Lef1","Lhx9","Rgs6")

```

```{R, fig3B.ARC.ATAC.dotplot, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, dev=c('png', 'pdf')}

seu_arc <- subset(ARC, tech=="ATAC")
count <- GetAssayData(seu_arc, assay = "RNA",slot = "data")
count <- as.matrix(count)

meta_rna <- seu_arc@meta.data

clust_share <- unique(seu_arc$cluster)

calPlot_list <- lapply(mark_ge, function(ge, mat, clust, meta){
  
  exp <- mat[ge,]
  
  exp_list <- lapply(clust, function(x, exp, meta2){
    cell_sel <- rownames(meta2)[meta2$cluster==x]
    ex <- exp[cell_sel]
    to <- length(exp)
    pos <- length(ex[ex > 0])
    med <- mean(ex)
    res <- setNames(c(med,(pos/to)*100),c("exp","prop"))
    return(res)}, exp, meta)
  
  names(exp_list) <- clust
  
  exp_mat <- do.call(rbind, exp_list)
  exp_dat <- data.frame(gene=ge,cluster=rownames(exp_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  exp_dat <- cbind(exp_dat,exp_mat)
  return(exp_dat)}, 
  count, clust_share, meta_rna)

names(calPlot_list) <- mark_ge
calPlot_dat <- do.call(rbind,calPlot_list)

calPlot_dat$cluster <- factor(calPlot_dat$cluster,levels = sort(as.numeric(as.vector(unique(calPlot_dat$cluster)))))
calPlot_dat$gene <- factor(calPlot_dat$gene, levels = unique(calPlot_dat$gene))

ggplot(calPlot_dat, aes(x=gene, y=cluster, size=prop, color=exp)) + geom_point() +
    labs(x="", y="Clusters", color="avg_exp", size="Percent") +
    scale_color_gradient(low="white", high = "darkblue") +
    theme_classic() + coord_flip()

```

```{R, fig3B.ARC.ATAC.heatmap, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, dev=c('png', 'pdf')}

calPlot_list <- lapply(levels(meta_rna$cluster), function(clust,ge,mat,meta){
  cell <- rownames(meta_rna)[meta_rna$cluster==clust]
  exp <- mat[ge,cell]
  exp2 <- apply(exp,1,mean)
  return(exp2)},mark_ge,count,meta_rna)

names(calPlot_list) <- levels(meta_rna$cluster)
calPlot_dat <- do.call(cbind,calPlot_list)
calPlot_dat <- calPlot_dat[!matrixStats::rowSds(calPlot_dat) == 0,]


colors <- colorRampPalette(c('blue', 'white', 'red'))(800)
breaksList = seq(-4, 4, by = 0.01)
pheatmap(calPlot_dat, scale = "row", cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         breaks = breaksList,
         color = colors)


```

## PVH

